key.name: view-mode
key.description: "list" for the details view, "icons" for the icon grid, "compact" for the small-icon multi-column list.

key.name: show-hidden
key.description: Whether dotfiles and GVFS-hidden entries are visible.

key.name: sort-descending
key.description: Sort descending instead of ascending; directories stay first.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Fallback icon size for directories without a saved zoom level (saved per directory in GVFS metadata).

key.name: terminal-command
key.description: Executable used for "Open in Terminal". Empty means automatic detection.

key.name: nextcloud-server
key.description: WebDAV server of the user's cloud: a bare host uses the Nextcloud/ownCloud convention (/remote.php/dav/files/<user>), a URL with path is used verbatim as the DAV endpoint. The app password is never stored here — it lives in the system keyring.

key.name: nextcloud-user
key.description: Login name on the configured WebDAV server.

key.name: nextcloud-sync-folders
key.description: Each tuple is (local path, remote path, direction, schedule): direction 0 = upload only, 1 = two-way; schedule -1 = live watch, 0 = manual only, >0 = interval in minutes.

key.name: verify-copies
key.description: Default state of the "Verify integrity" checkbox in the copy progress dialog. When enabled, each copied file is hashed (BLAKE3) and the destination re-read for comparison; reflink copies skip verification because they share extents by construction.

key.name: copy-parallel
key.summary: Copy files with a worker pool
key.description: When enabled, file payloads of a copy batch are copied by multiple worker threads (walk, directory creation and conflict resolution stay sequential). Helps most on SSDs/NVMe with many small files; rotating disks and network mounts can get slower.

key.name: copy-workers
key.description: Worker threads used for parallel copying; the UI caps this at the machine's CPU core count.

key.name: terminal-panel-visible
key.description: Whether the embedded terminal (View menu, F4) is open at the bottom of the window.

key.name: terminal-panel-height
key.description: Pixel height of the embedded terminal panel; restored on next show.

key.name: secure-delete
key.summary: Overwrite files before permanently deleting them
key.description: When enabled, permanent deletion (Shift+Delete / "Delete permanently") overwrites every regular file with random data before unlinking it. Best-effort privacy on HDDs; not a guarantee on SSDs or copy-on-write filesystems.

key.name: secure-delete-passes
key.summary: Number of overwrite passes for secure delete
key.description: How many times file content is overwritten before permanent deletion.

key.name: thumbnails-images-mode
key.summary: Image thumbnail policy: always, limit or never

key.name: context-menu-hidden
key.summary: Context menu entries hidden by the user
key.description: Entry ids the user hid via Preferences → Context menu. Applies wherever the entry exists.

key.name: bookmarks
key.summary: User bookmarks shown in the sidebar
key.description: URIs of bookmarked locations, in display order.
